svg.text: Decode speed, 36 varied prompts, 3 interleaved runs each (tok/s, higher is better)
RTX 5070 12 GiB, i7-11700K, 64 GiB RAM, same model file. Strata = local build-0145 on its tuned config.
Shadow default is +12.5% against Strata; held to the same 8,192-token context Shadow is -6.2%.
Different engines write different text, so the score is total tokens / total generating time. Prompt speed not measured.
Data: bench/vs-strata-final-2026-11-11. Method and caveats: docs/COMPARISON_STRATA_2026-11-11.md
